Iran recalls striker Azmoun after World Cup omission controversy

Iran has recalled star striker Sardar Azmoun following his controversial omission from the World Cup squad. Azmoun stated there is no bitterness over the decision. The recall comes after his earlier exclusion from the World Cup team.
